site.name: The Long Ball
site.tagline: Digging the data behind the distance.

description: Rule-based weekly Long Ball content report covering LBI movement, power signals, pitcher damage, and Tale of the Tape highlights.
sourceNotes: Uses weekly movers snapshots, current Longball Index data, current Hot Dog Stand data, and archived Tale of the Tape daily features. Power Gap and Surprise Pop are descriptive, not predictive.

fields.stockUp: Biggest LBI risers from the weekly movers report.
fields.stockDown: Biggest LBI fallers from the weekly movers report.
fields.powerGap: Signed expected-HR gap. Positive values mean expected HR is running ahead of actual HR, with Longball Index support.
fields.surprisePop: Non-obvious bats flashing real longball ingredients, filtered away from current HR leaders.
fields.powerMirage: The negative/context-heavy tail of Power Gap: HR output, Cheapies, or short-porch context running ahead of longball quality.
fields.gettingCooked: Pitchers currently allowing HR-capable contact most often by Getting Cooked, with cumulative Hot Dog Damage context.
fields.taleOfTheTapeRecap: Daily Dong, Hot Dog Robbery, and Cheapest Dong highlights from recent Tale archives.

powerGapExplainer: Signed expected-HR gap. Positive values mean expected HR is running ahead of actual HR; this tail requires strong Longball Index support.
surprisePopExplainer: Non-obvious bats flashing real longball ingredients. Descriptive context only.
powerMirageExplainer: The other tail of Power Gap: HR output, Cheapies, or short-porch context running ahead of longball quality. Descriptive context only.
gettingCookedExplainer: Pitchers whose Getting Cooked score is flashing, with cumulative Hot Dog Damage shown as context.

powerGapSortComparison.recommendation: Keep signed Power Gap sorting for clarity.

surprisePopFilter.description: Current-obvious plus prior HR, HR/600, LBI, and two-year established-power exclusions.

filterVariants.description: Current-obvious plus prior two-year average LBI >= 130.

Current-obvious plus softer established-power exclusions: prior HR >= 30, prior two-year HR/600 >= 35, or prior two-year LBI >= 145.
